description: RevenueDot's MIT fork of RevenueCat's Cordova plugin, pointed at RevenueDot, the open-source RevenueCat alternative for in-app purchases and subscriptions.
rules: Install with `cordova plugin add @revenuedot/cordova-plugin-purchases@<version>`. The plugin id stays cordova-plugin-purchases and the global stays `Purchases`.
Call `Purchases.configureWith` after the `deviceready` event, with the app's public key from the RevenueDot dashboard: appl_ for iOS and goog_ for Android.
RevenueDot Cloud (https://api.revenuedot.app) is the default API host. For a self-hosted server, call `Purchases.setProxyURL("https://revenuedot.example.com")` before `configureWith`.
